msg: The dark coloured gnomes (pink, purple, brown gnomes) and the bright coloured gnomes (green, yellow / orange, blue) are separate from one another.One group will receive more mushrooms at times and vice versa. To get the most mushrooms you must work out the pattern. If there are 4 or over on a x1 stick with that gnome group and when you get x5 youll be getting 20,25,30,35,40 mushrooms. But after the x5 it will go back to x1. As it reset you will need to do the same with the other gnome group. If you switch too soon you will receive low scores ( 3 and under)
